name: Hist sick (4E 201)
why: the town as the player finds it (record faith, main-plot's sick Hist, MN01, MN02, MN04): the living tree with its glands dried shut (King of the Murkmire's dead glands), half its flowers, its dead roots round it and the cooling egg-pool; the bark's darkening is told by Weeltul (the build has no darker bark of the living tree)

name: Hist healed, pool warm (ending Use)
why: MN19's Use ending ('At Jal-Veesa the grey bark softens and the scar weeps sap'): the living glands open and every flower blooms; the egg-pool stays

name: Hist dead, people gone (endings Take and Give)
why: MN19's Take and Give endings ('the pools go cold, and the people leave'; thing.mn19.dead-hists): King of the Murkmire's dead twin of the Hist in its pose (HistTree01Dead), the eggs, nests, sap pool and flowers gone with the living tree, and the town's 22 people switched off
